text:
Which reaction involving sulfur dioxide is correct?
A
It is produced during the extraction of zinc from zinc blende.
B
It reacts with concentrated sulfuric acid to form oleum.
C
It reacts with sulfur to form sulfur trioxide.
It turns an acidified solution of potassium manganate(VII) purple.
D

options.label: A
options.text: It is produced during the extraction of zinc from zinc blende.

options.label: B
options.text: It reacts with concentrated sulfuric acid to form oleum.

options.label: C
options.text: It reacts with sulfur to form sulfur trioxide.

options.label: D
options.text: It turns an acidified solution of potassium manganate(VII) purple.
